import numpy as np
from scipy import stats

MAX_DRIVERS = 2

def design(feats):
    # Filter out derived features for mechanism discovery
    non_derived_ids = [fid for fid, typ in zip(feats.ids, feats.types) if typ != 'derived']
    
    # Calculate effect sizes (mean difference in outcome groups)
    effect_sizes = []
    for i, fid in enumerate(non_derived_ids):
        col_idx = feats.column(fid)
        x = feats.x[:, col_idx]
        y = feats.y
        mean_y1 = np.mean(x[y == 1])
        mean_y0 = np.mean(x[y == 0])
        effect_size = mean_y1 - mean_y0
        effect_sizes.append((effect_size, fid))
    
    # Sort by absolute effect size
    effect_sizes.sort(key=lambda x: abs(x[0]), reverse=True)
    
    # Select top candidates for drivers
    drivers = [fid for _, fid in effect_sizes[:MAX_DRIVERS]]
    
    # Remove near-duplicates based on correlation > 0.6
    non_derived_indices = [feats.column(fid) for fid in non_derived_ids]
    corr_matrix = np.corrcoef(feats.x[:, non_derived_indices].T)
    correlated_pairs = set()
    for i in range(len(non_derived_ids)):
        for j in range(i+1, len(non_derived_ids)):
            if abs(corr_matrix[i,j]) >= 0.6:
                fid1, fid2 = non_derived_ids[i], non_derived_ids[j]
                correlated_pairs.add((min(fid1, fid2), max(fid1, fid2)))
    
    # Keep only one from each correlated pair
    selected_drivers = []
    used = set()
    for fid in drivers:
        if fid in used:
            continue
        # Check if this feature is correlated with any already selected
        is_correlated = False
        for selected_fid in selected_drivers:
            if (min(fid, selected_fid), max(fid, selected_fid)) in correlated_pairs:
                is_correlated = True
                break
        if not is_correlated:
            selected_drivers.append(fid)
            used.add(fid)
    
    # Use only selected drivers for regression (columns)
    columns = tuple(selected_drivers)
    
    # Check for interaction terms between top drivers
    products = []
    if len(selected_drivers) >= 2:
        # Add interaction term between first two drivers
        products = [(selected_drivers[0], selected_drivers[1])]
    
    # Weighted score: use standardized values of selected drivers
    loadings = {}
    for fid in selected_drivers:
        idx = feats.column(fid)
        loadings[fid] = np.std(feats.x[:, idx])
    
    return Design(
        drivers=tuple(selected_drivers),
        columns=columns,
        products=tuple(products),
        loadings=loadings
    )
